description: Enhanced multi-topic batch coverage: a batch spanning three distinct topics emits one span per message named by its own topic in declaration order, and a batch carrying a single topic group with three messages emits three same-named producer spans each on its own trace.

inject msg=0 carries=span#0
inject msg=1 carries=span#1
inject msg=2 carries=span#2

  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-a
  messaging.destination_kind=topic

  messaging.system=kafka
